No firm timeline announced. Grok 4.8 finished pretraining mid-September and entered RL as a noticeable step up from 4.7. 4.9 aims for current Astra/Fable parity. Leading the full suite may come with Grok 5 or later, depending on post-training results and evals. Rapid iteration…
